subject: Capacity handoff: onboarding run schedule, roles, and test runbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Agarwal <sanjay@heliohealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity handoff: onboarding run schedule, roles, and test runbook

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation we want to lock the acceptance window and clarify roles for the throughput/latency runs so there are no surprises during your integration test. Attached is a first-pass runbook and the test matrix (CSV) showing the scenarios we plan to execute. Key asks below: 

- Confirm a 2-hour slot on April 5 or April 6 (PST) for the initial baseline run (steady-state throughput + tail-latency sampling).
- Confirm the list of HelioHealth endpoints you want us to drive (API paths + typical payload sizes).
- Identify an internal HelioHealth point-of-contact for run-day coordination and a fallback for network issues.

What we will do: Redwood will provision a dedicated pool, run the scripted load scenarios, collect token-level latency traces, and produce a concise evidence packet (CSV + annotated logs). Our acceptance criteria (proposed):

- 95th percentile generation latency < 400ms for nominal payloads (<= 512 tokens)
- Sustained throughput >= 120 requests/sec for the core routing policy
- No >5% error rate during steady-state windows

Ben (CS lead) will own run execution and Monica will manage the evidence handoff into your compliance folder. I copied them here so we have alignment on roles.

Attachments: helio_load_runbook_v1.pdf (PDF), helio_test_matrix.csv (CSV)

Next steps if you confirm: we will circulate a minute-by-minute run schedule, pre-run checklist (auth tokens, IP allowlist), and an ephemeral dashboard link for live telemetry.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0184

[Redwood Inference]

From: Sanjay Agarwal <sanjay@heliohealth.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: HelioHealth Platform Team <platform@heliohealth.ai>
Date: 2028-04-01T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity handoff: onboarding run schedule, roles, and test runbook

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock times: 

1) Payloads: we'll supply 3 endpoint variants — /v1/triage (small), /v1/annotate (medium), /v1/contextualize (large, sometimes up to 1,200 tokens). For the large requests we expect lower throughput — is it ok to run those separately as a burst test?

2) IP allowlist: Operations will need the public IP range that Redwood will use for the dedicated pool. Can you provide an ephemeral CIDR list by EOD?

3) Evidence format: legal asks that logs be retained for 90 days. Monica — can you confirm that the evidence packet will include immutable traces and a short statement of compliance?

We prefer April 6, 10:00–12:30 PST if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Sanjay Agarwal
Head of Platform | HelioHealth
platform@heliohealth.ai

	[HelioHealth]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sanjay Agarwal <sanjay@heliohealth.ai>
Date: 2028-04-02T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity handoff: onboarding run schedule, roles, and test runbook

Sanjay / team —

Confirming April 6, 10:00–12:30 PST works for Redwood. Quick answers to your points: 

1) Large payloads: yes — we will treat /v1/contextualize as a separate burst scenario. The runbook enumerates a main steady-state phase (mix of small+medium) then a separate burst phase for the large payloads so it doesn't skew the 95th pctl baseline.

2) IP list: attaching ephemeral CIDRs used by the dedicated pool. They rotate per run but we will provide a concretized list 24 hours prior to the run. (Attachment stub below.)

3) Evidence retention/format: Monica — can you confirm the retention and compliance note?

I uploaded a minimal minute-by-minute schedule into the shared Drive (link below) and will stand up the temporary telemetry dashboard. Run-day roles: 
- Ben Carter: run execution, load orchestration, live remediation
- Monica Patel: evidence capture, tracing artifacts, upload to HelioHealth folder
- Jordan Blake: stakeholder updates and escalation interface
- HelioHealth POC (Sanjay): acceptance sign-off and local network coordination

Attachments referenced: redwood_dedicated_cidrs_run_20280406.txt (TXT)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cHelioOnboard
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567890

-ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

[Attachment stub: redwood_dedicated_cidrs_run_20280406.txt]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Agarwal <sanjay@heliohealth.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity handoff: onboarding run schedule, roles, and test runbook

Hi all —

Confirmed on our side: evidence package will include token-level latency CSVs, per-request traces (anonymized request ids), and a 1-page compliance statement indicating retention duration and hash pointers for immutable logs. We will upload everything to the HelioHealth folder within 24 hours of the run completion.

Pre-run checklist (short):
- HelioHealth to confirm IP allowlist completed 24h prior
- HelioHealth to provide API keys / temp creds and test endpoints 48h prior
- Redwood to validate payload sizes against the CSV test matrix 24h prior
- Go/no-go call 30 minutes before start (15 min if all green)

Sanjay — for completeness I added Lauren from our Solutions Engineering (copied) to assist on authentication and observability hooks. If anything changes to your endpoints (e.g., the 1,200 token cap on /v1/contextualize) flag it now so we can update the matrix.

See you Thursday 10:00 PST — I'll share the final minute-by-minute schedule and the ephemeral dashboard URL the morning of the run.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

[Attachments referenced earlier: helio_load_runbook_v1.pdf, helio_test_matrix.csv]
